message.text:
No per-user API rate-limiting middleware exists. Echo only registers Recover and CORS. Semaphores exist for thumbnail and image processing concurrency, but these are not request limits.

The email documentation lists rate limiting as a suggestion, not an implemented feature.

r02.
There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware and no request-quota config. Echo only registers Recover and CORS (`server/server.go`); auth is an interceptor, not a rate limiter.
